reason: PURE. First thing I noticed was the pocket-size sachet that tears open with one hand, because I forget pills at home and live out of my tote, so one sachet tossed in the bag actually fits my life. I'd try one box of the plain bisglycinate, since the 3-form one is more to figure out.
objection: 'Every batch lab-tested' with a QR code sounds like marketing, everyone says tested. I'd scan it once, and if the report isn't a real batch report from a named lab I'd not reorder.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a real batch report with the lab name and numbers when I scan the QR, or a cheaper first box to try.
